OLLAMA_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install OLLAMA. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise', 'asdf', 'pkgx', or 'vfox' defers to third-party tools.

OLLAMA_MODELS.description: Directory path where Ollama stores downloaded model weights and manifests.

OLLAMA_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading ollama binary or archive artifacts.

OLLAMA_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying ollama available remote releases.

OLLAMA_VERSION.description: Specific version of ollama to install (e.g., latest, lts, or exact version).

OLLAMA_MODELS_DIR.description: Unambiguous filesystem directory path for Ollama daemon model storage, avoiding collision with application-level OLLAMA_MODELS.

OLLAMA_DEFAULT_MODEL.description: Default Ollama model tag to pull and verify when no explicit model list is provided.

OLLAMA_HOST.description: Host and port URL where the Ollama HTTP API listens (default: http://127.0.0.1:11434).

OLLAMA_MODEL_LIST.description: Comma- or space-separated list of Ollama model tags to ensure are pulled and registered.

OLLAMA_READY_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum time in seconds to poll the Ollama HTTP API for readiness after service start or restart.

OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL.description: Maximum number of parallel requests each loaded Ollama model processes simultaneously (default: 1).

OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS.description: Maximum number of Ollama models kept loaded concurrently in memory (default: 1).

OLLAMA_LLM_LIBRARY.description: GGML CPU/GPU backend library override for Ollama llama-server (e.g. 'cpu_avx2' on GPU-less VMs to prevent AVX-512/AMX segmentation faults).

OLLAMA_NUM_GPU.description: Number of model layers to offload to GPU (set to '0' on CPU-only nodes to disable headless GPU probing).

OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION.description: Whether to enable experimental flash attention kernels in Ollama ('0' disables CPU flash attention to prevent crashes).

OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE.description: Data type for Ollama KV cache memory allocation (default: 'f16').

OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH.description: Default context window length in tokens allocated by Ollama llama-server (default: '2048').

OLLAMA_MAX_QUEUE.description: Maximum number of queued generation requests in the Ollama server (default: '16').

OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE.description: Duration models remain loaded in memory after an inference request (default: '10m').

GGML_BACKEND_AMX.description: Controls Intel AMX backend buffer allocation in GGML/llama-server (set to '0' to prevent ggml_backend_amx_buffer_type_alloc_buffer segmentation faults on Intel Sapphire/Emerald Rapids CPUs).

OLLAMA_VERIFY_INFERENCE.description: When set to '1', runs a 1-token /api/generate smoke test on pulled models and re-pulls if llama-server crashes.
